# fast-jev-compaction

Source: https://github.com/tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction

Commit: e3f262a7f4d42bd8dd32ced30d26176f7cb545b0

The included compact.js, state.js and request.js are the compiled runtime of the corresponding src/*.ts files, with source-map comments omitted. The upstream MIT license is included in LICENSE. No upstream platform hook is installed. Shiftblame's transport, validation, dependency pinning and memory ownership are implemented outside these files in jev-compact.mjs.
